title: Persist denials and block equivalent actions across retries
narrative: Denied intents and side-effect classes survive graph retries and delegated paths. A denied send cannot be retried through a second provider or tool without new explicit authorization. Native deny/allow paths: `fangore_insp_soft_vs_hard`, `fangore_jev_action_safety`. Tracks MH-DOTS-05[^insp-dots-05].
implementation: `DenialStore` (ABC) with `InMemoryDenialStore` keys denials by `equivalent_action_digest(effect_class, target, ...)`, which ignores tool/provider names. `AuthorityGate` consults the store first (`prior_denial`) and records policy `DENY` verdicts. `lift()` is the explicit new-authorization path. Hosts bind a durable store; the in-memory store is not restart-durable.
validation: Harness `cli` `probe` loads `plans/denial_store_equivalence.yaml` (human-readable probe plan); hard expects on declared observation keys.
